# List all unique tool names used by the agent
used_tools = set()
for i in range(1, 146):
    sr = await CONTEXT.search(f"[tool {i}] ")
    for item in sr.get('items', []):
        off = item['offset']
        txt = await CONTEXT.read(off, 300)
        # Extract tool name
        parts = txt.split(']')
        if len(parts) > 1:
            tool_line = parts[1].strip()
            tool_name = tool_line.split(' ')[0].split('{')[0].strip()
            used_tools.add(tool_name)

print("Tools used by agent:")
for t in sorted(used_tools):
    print(f"  {t}")

# Also check what "checkpoint" says - what files changed
cp = await CONTEXT.search("[checkpoint")
for item in cp.get('items', []):
    off = item['offset']
    txt = await CONTEXT.read(off, 300)
    print(f"\nCheckpoint:")
    print(txt[:300])
